shortDescription: Demonstrates a road maintenance scheduling problem with crews, due dates and area conflicts.
longDescription: Schedules 28 road maintenance jobs onto 4 crews over a 12-week window of workdays. Each job takes 1 to 10 workdays, may only start once it is ready, must be finished by its due date, and carries the area it takes place in as a tag. Once solved, every job runs on exactly one crew inside its window, as close as possible to its ideal end date, and jobs in the same area no longer overlap.
